name: Mima Menu Builder
author: mansari147

sections.description:
Mima Menu Builder is a modern, all-in-one restaurant menu plugin built and battle-tested in a real restaurant.
It includes built-in multilingual fields and multi-currency display, so you don’t need extra plugins like WPML or currency switchers.

Create a clean, professional, and flexible restaurant menu that works perfectly in both LTR and RTL languages.

Key Features
– Built-in multilingual content fields (auto RTL detection)
– Multi-currency price display (switchable)
– Lightweight frontend theme (Theme 1) with sticky category row & filtering
– Admin panels for categories, items, add-on groups/items, languages, and settings
– “Best Seller” / “Available” flags with AJAX toggles
– Optional Screen Saver mode for interactive menu pages
– Optimized asset loading (scripts/styles only on the menu page)

All-in-One
Everything is inside Mima Menu Builder — no need for WPML, Polylang, or currency add-ons.
Just install, activate, and configure your menu.

Roadmap

We’re actively improving Mima Menu Builder. Upcoming features include:
– Ordering & checkout system
– Table reservation
– Additional frontend themes
– More design & layout customization options
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate it via Plugins in your dashboard.
  3. Open Mima Menu Builder in the admin panel and configure languages, currencies, categories, and items.
  4. Create your Menu page — Theme 1 auto-detects it (or use the [mima_menu] shortcode if needed).
sections.faq:
Does it support RTL?

Yes. RTL is auto-detected for supported languages.

Do I need extra plugins for languages or currencies?

No. Mima Menu Builder handles multilingual content and multi-currency display internally.

Can I take orders with this plugin?

Not yet. Ordering and reservation features are coming soon.

What is the Screen Saver feature?

It’s an optional mode that adds an interactive “screensaver-style” effect to your menu page.
You can enable or disable it from the plugin settings.
